title: tau config show output
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau config show` (and `tau config show --json`) prints on stdout: the resolved effective config — config file + environment + CLI flags merged, exactly as a run would see it. Secrets are never emitted: api_key.value is masked and api_key.source reports which precedence level supplied the key. Every key is always present; fields that do not apply serialize as null. `--origin` adds an `origins` member attributing each value to the layer that supplied it. New keys may be added (additive); existing keys keep their names and types.

config_file.description: Where configuration was loaded from. The file is optional — defaults fill whatever it does not set.

path.description: Probed config path (~/.config/tau/config.json); null when HOME is unset.

exists.description: Whether a config file was actually read.

warning.description: Parse/degradation warning (e.g. invalid JSON — load continues with defaults); null when the file is absent or clean.

provider.description: Resolved provider name (registry entry or flag/config/env override).

model.description: Resolved model id (provider default unless overridden).

endpoint_source.description: Where the final endpoint came from — the provider table or a TAU_ENDPOINT override.

api_key.description: Resolved API key — the value is always masked; provenance is reported instead.

set.description: Whether any precedence level resolved a key.

value.description: Redacted key (prefix + mask), never the raw secret; null when unset.

source.description: Precedence level that supplied the key: "--api-key", "config keys[<provider>]", "env <NAME>", "config api_key", "env TAU_API_KEY", or "builtin"; null when unset.

keys.description: Per-provider keys from the config file, each value redacted; null when the file defines none.

session.description: Session name when persistence is enabled; null otherwise.

tools_allow.description: Tool allowlist (CSV order); null = all tools enabled.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; null when a non-finite value was parsed (e.g. --temperature nan).

compact_threshold.description: Fraction of context_window that triggers compaction; null when non-finite.

origins.description: Present only with `tau config show --origin`: maps every effective-config field to the layer that supplied its value — "default" (compiled default), "provider" (provider registry-table value, e.g. the default model/endpoint/context_window), "file" (the loaded config file), "env:<VAR>" (environment variable), or "flag:<--flag>" (a CLI flag). api_key's origin reuses the resolved-key provenance; endpoint mirrors endpoint_source.

api_key.description: Layer that supplied the resolved key: "file" (config api_key or keys[<provider>]), "env:<VAR>" (provider env var or TAU_API_KEY), "flag:--api-key", "provider" (builtin), or "default" when unset.
